# Terms

## Venue
A physical location where a merchant sells.
- instead-of: store, shop
- except: data store

## Product
A sellable thing in a Venue catalogue.
- instead-of: item

## Order Line
One Product on one order, with its quantity and price.
- instead-of: line item
